messages:
elaine: Heads-up from CS — SmallBank just reported a repeat of p99 token latency spikes on their Dedicated pool for the last ~45m. They're quoting an SLA window breach if this continues. Can eng-platform take a commitment on a mitigation timeline? :warning:

sanjay: Thanks @elaine — taking point. Can you paste the error/trace or attach a sample trace id? Also need to know if this is isolated to SmallBank or hitting multiple tenants.

taylor: Observed this in the metrics: pool3 tail latency jump starting ~10:12 UTC, correlated with a burst of KV cache misses and model engine reloads. Only seen in a few large-context sessions (>= 12k tokens) — SmallBank routes heavily use long chat histories. Sample log snippet:```
[2024-06-20T10:13:02Z] pool=pool3 model=rwkv-14b trace=trc-9a2f miss=1 kv_miss=78 tail_ms=2460
[2024-06-20T10:13:03Z] pool=pool3 model=rwkv-14b reload=true gpu_busy=0.98 queue_len=22
```

leo: Quick note — I saw a related autoscaler change yesterday that lowered max idle time before recycle from 15m -> 3m in pool3. That increases reload churn under bursty traffic; could explain the reload/KV-miss storm. Config diff:```
- gpu_idle_recycle_seconds: 900
+ gpu_idle_recycle_seconds: 180
```

sanjay: OK, plan sketch: 1) short-term mitigation: route SmallBank to hosted fallback variant or pin them to a warm-only pool and disable aggressive recycling (costly but restores SLA). 2) medium: rollback autoscaler change for pool3 and add sticky warm slots. 3) longer: KV cache prewarm on reload and better cache preservation during reloads. Need owners & ETA.

elaine: SmallBank prefers a workaround within 3 hours. They can accept routed-to-hosted if we give a cost estimate.

taylor: I'll triage live now and confirm whether a rollback toggles the spike. Expect findings in ~30m. Owner: taylor (triage) + leo (runtime).

leo: I can patch the autoscaler config to revert to 900s and start a canary rollback on 1 host group. If successful we can roll through pool3 within ~1.5-2h. Deploy plan: canary -> monitor 15m -> roll. If canary shows improvement will continue.

sanjay: I'll do traffic steering to hosted fallback for SmallBank as the immediate fallback. ETA: ~25-40m to finish route change + customer notif. Cost impact: estimated extra $2-3k/day at current traffic. Elaine pls confirm customer ok.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered by leo on pool3-hostgroup-7 (id: canary-20240620-171890) — started 10:55 UTC. Monitoring hooks: tail_latency, kv_miss_rate, reload_count.

elaine: Confirmed with SmallBank — they accept hosted fallback for now if we give an update once rollback finished. I've told them ETA ~2h for full mitigation.

taylor: Update after 30m triage: can reproduce locally, KV miss rate dropped by ~70% on the canary host after reverting recycle timeout. Logs show reduced reloads and queue length. Next: decide to continue roll.

leo: Rolling through remaining hosts now. Rolling rate: 4 hosts / 10m to avoid mass reload. Expected complete by ~2h from orig message.

sanjay: Action items (owners):
- taylor: produce final triage note + root cause summary (in 1h)
- leo: complete rollback and post canary metrics (in 2h)
- sanjay: traffic steer to hosted fallback (in 40m) and cost update
- elaine: customer comms and SLA update (ongoing)

elaine: Thanks team — I'll send an interim note to SmallBank now. Please ping me when canary shows green or if anything regresses. :pray:

leo: Canary results posted — tail p99 down 80% on canary hosts, kv_miss_rate normalizing. Continuing rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 6/6 hostgroups updated, monitoring indicates stabilization. No regressions detected in 20m window.

taylor: Closing the loop: root cause = aggressive GPU recycle causing reload cascades with KV cache invalidation under long-context traffic. Remediation = revert recycle timeout + add sticky warm slots + plan KV prewarm fix. I will open the follow-up ticket with priority P1 and link to this thread.

sanjay: Commitment summary for SLA: immediate routing to hosted fallback (done) + rollback complete (done) — we estimate risk mitigated. Owner commit: permanent fix (KV prewarm + sticky warm) targeted by EOD for this week, will update ticket with exact PR/ETA.

elaine: Great, customer notified and happy with progress. Marking as "customer notified, mitigated" for now — will wait for taylor's ticket. Thanks all. :tada:
